interpretation.not_a_gate: Recorded as a baseline. A threshold set before the distribution is known is a guess.
interpretation.what_this_does_not_measure: It is not a recall figure. A redaction inside vulnerable-by-design source may be correct, because that source really does contain hardcoded credentials; those alterations are counted in the rate and deliberately not judged here.
interpretation.what_this_measures: How the egress guardrail behaves on the content this gateway actually carries. Unambiguous false positives are decided by structure, not by opinion: the contexts listed cannot hold a credential.
